name: tl;dv
desc: Meeting recorder that extracts the moments worth keeping.
desc_zh: 会议录制与 AI 高光片段提取
solves: Nobody sits through the recording again. tl;dv pulls the moments out and logs them to the CRM on its own.
solves_zh: 没人会再看一遍录像。tl;dv 把高光片段挑出来，自己写进 CRM。
best_for: Calls back to back all day, where only the key moments are worth keeping.
best_for_zh: 会议一整天连着开，只有关键片刻值得留下。
